decisions.rationale: End the partial-mapping pattern by narrowing claims, not by adding more teaching: the project plan maps each part to the specific objective requirements it actually teaches, checks, applies and publicly tests (for example 'updating-state-immutably#o2 (add/remove)'), and marks every compound objective as partially covered by the project, with full coverage owned by its topic page and quiz. Remove the blanket line-185 claim that every listed objective is fully covered. No change to syllabus, calendar blocks or teaching minutes is required.

Same narrowing: P5 claims only the UI-testing requirements its public checks verify (role and label queries, a passing learner test). Map o2 (getBy/queryBy/findBy choice) as partially covered and owned by the topic page, or add one observable public check for a query choice if it fits the part's minutes. Tests stay public, with no model answers.
